definitions.quality/hq.txt.gz: Both scores strictly above their global 60th percentile.
definitions.quality/hq_topP.txt.gz: Both scores strictly above global (100-P)th percentiles, before test exclusion; quality/hq.txt.gz is the raw Top40 pool.
definitions.quality/lq.txt.gz: Both scores strictly below their global 20th percentile.
definitions.test/gallery.txt.gz: One seeded raw HQ choice per selected identity, fixed for every method.
definitions.test/heldout_all.txt.gz: All HQ, LQ and other images of selected retrieval-test identities.
definitions.test/iqa.txt.gz: Seeded sample of LQ images from identities absent from raw HQ.
definitions.test/queries.txt.gz: Every LQ image of the selected retrieval-test identities.
definitions.train/hq_topP.txt.gz: Both scores strictly above global (100-P)th percentiles, excluding every retrieval-test identity; P is not a final retained percentage.
definitions.train/identity_disjoint.txt.gz: Legacy woid intermediate: all crops minus retrieval-test identities. Still includes IQA test sources; do not use as a final training manifest.
definitions.train/lq.txt.gz: Raw LQ with an identity present in train/hq_top40; the exact effective original Stage 2 LQ population.
definitions.train/without_lq.txt.gz: All crops minus retrieval-test identities minus raw LQ.
definitions.train/without_test_images.txt.gz: Legacy wotest intermediate: all crops minus only the IQA test images. Includes retrieval-test identities; do not use as a final training manifest.

identity_key: immediate parent directory name, matching the original pipeline
source_key: canonical source path relative to all_faces, preserving nested directories
threshold_comparison: original float64 scores; strict < for LQ, > for HQ/Top
threshold_population: all scored accepted crops, before test exclusion
